description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR1. sweep_corpus_for_return_widening (src/compiler2/drive_test.rs ~19614) reads fixtures2/ with a non-recursive read_dir, so fixtures2/behavior/, including json_roundtrip.fz, is never swept; an 18-revision runaway trips no gate. Make it recursive, take the red (corpus_max_return_changes <= 5 and !widened will fail on behavior/), and pin the measured values with fz-kdt.177 named as the owner of the defect. Loud and proud: a pinned defect, not a raised limit.
title: The corpus widening sweep reads every fixture directory
